sam_ops: Heads up — we noticed contract/promo credits didn’t apply on the March Dedicated invoice INV-2026-03-72. Billing lines for reserved GPUs look like they were attributed to a different billing subaccount. Anyone seen this before? :eyes:
kevin_finance: Which invoice id and any example lines? can you paste the raw invoice snippet?
alex_chung: FYI we recently discovered some node pools still had an old network tag that routes egress through partner NAT — that can surface as charges on a partner subaccount instead of redwood-main. Might be related.
sam_ops: Pasting the invoice snippet we pulled from the export:
```
Invoice: INV-2026-03-72
line_item: DEDICATED_GPU_N1
amount: 12345.00
billing_project: projects-redwood-prod-dedicated
billing_subaccount: partner-ops-eu
credits_applied: 0
expected_credit: 10000.00 (promo_contract_2025Q4)
```
maria_p: If charges landed under partner-ops-eu, credits tied to redwood-main won't auto-apply. Promo and contract credits are applied at the billing account level. Two options: (1) vendor remap historical charges to redwood-main, or (2) vendor issues a one-off credit to our account. Also check whether those SKUs are covered by commitment credits — commitments sometimes follow a different ledger flow.
billing-bot: Ledger: promo_contract_2025Q4 applied -> account:redwood-main -> amount:10000.00 -> status:applied -> date:2025-12-01
sam_ops: Invoice id confirmed INV-2026-03-72. Alex, which nodes had that legacy tag? need node names + cluster.
alex_chung: Nodes: gpu-pool-05, gpu-pool-06, gpu-pool-07 in cluster prod-dedicated-eu-west1. Legacy label `billing:partner-ops-eu` on node metadata. I removed the label and restarted the egress daemonset to reassign NAT. This will affect future billing; historical charges still need remap.
kevin_finance: Can you run the cloud billing query and paste the invoice rows? e.g. ```gcloud alpha billing accounts invoices list --filter='invoiceId=INV-2026-03-72' --format=json``` and also export the BigQuery rows for the invoice id. We need the exact billing_account_id values.
sam_ops: Quick BigQuery extract (trimmed):
```
{billing_account_id: "partner-ops-eu", cost: 12345.00, sku: "DEDICATED_GPU_N1", resource_name: "projects/redwood-prod-dedicated/instances/gpu-pool-06"}
```
maria_p: If cloud support refuses remap, finance can apply an internal ledger adjustment to credit the month, but that will affect our ARR/expense metrics (we'll need a journal entry). Let's try vendor remap first. Also check promo expiration windows — some promos expire on invoice generation date, so timing matters.
kevin_finance: I've emailed the Cloud AM and opened a vendor escalation; cc: @maria_p @sam_ops. Action items:
- ops (sam): open cloud support ticket with invoice lines, BigQuery export link, and node list.
- infra (alex): confirm tag fix and provide a short note that changes went live before next billing cycle.
- finance (kevin/maria): prepare potential ledger adjustment runbook if vendor declines.
sam_ops: Opened cloud ticket CLOUD-123456 and attached logs + invoice export. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/CLOUD-123456 (internal)
billing-bot: Case CLOUD-123456 created; owner: Cloud AM; priority: P2
sam_ops: For immediate capacity safety, moved noncritical workloads off gpu-pool-05..07 to fallback pool to avoid further cross-account billing. Will update once cloud responds. :white_check_mark:
